promptSummary: Create Deepforge Miner as a space mining incremental clicker for the Clicker Management Hall, with click-to-mine mechanic, automated drones, four upgrade tiers, five resource types unlocked via prestige, canvas-based visual effects, and clear progression feedback. The original package targeted Observation 006; archive integration later assigned Observation 009 because slot 006 was occupied.

notes: Deepforge Miner's economy was designed to produce satisfying incremental progression: drone cost scaling at 1.15x per drone creates diminishing returns, upgrade tiers provide 10x click power jumps, prestige resets with +25% cumulative permanent bonus, and resource tiers gate content behind prestige count. The canvas rendering pipeline draws a procedurally shaped asteroid with animated ore veins, orbiting drone ships, particle bursts on click, floating damage numbers, and expanding click rings — all at 60fps with no external dependencies. The archive number was changed from the original 006 target to 009 during integration; gameplay and economy were not changed.
